title: Midcentury Geometric
description: Ce style utilise des formes géométriques plates et sans ombres, caractéristiques de l'illustration moderne du milieu du siècle et de l'art vectoriel minimaliste. Il présente des bords tranchants, une absence de contours et s'appuie entièrement sur des blocs de couleurs mates à fort contraste pour définir les formes et la profondeur spatiale.
description_en: This style utilizes flat, unshaded geometric shapes characteristic of mid-century modern illustration and minimalist vector art. It features razor-sharp edges, an absence of outlines, and relies entirely on high-contrast, matte color blocking to define forms and spatial depth.
description_fr: Ce style utilise des formes géométriques plates et sans ombres, caractéristiques de l'illustration moderne du milieu du siècle et de l'art vectoriel minimaliste. Il présente des bords tranchants, une absence de contours et s'appuie entièrement sur des blocs de couleurs mates à fort contraste pour définir les formes et la profondeur spatiale.
prompt: Flat vector minimalist illustration, mid-century modern graphic design, unshaded geometric shapes. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Rely entirely on distinct, unshaded planes of color to construct the composition. No gradients, no shadows, no highlights, no ambient occlusion. Forms are built from crisp, hard-edged geometric polygons and simplified silhouettes. Edges are razor-sharp with no outlines, linework, or strokes separating the elements. Spatial depth is achieved exclusively through the overlapping of flat 2D layers, often using diagonal or horizontal color blocking. The color palette features a matte finish, utilizing {{primary_color}} as the dominant base, accented by striking pops of {{accent_color}}, and balanced with flat fields of {{secondary_color}}. Textures are completely smooth and digital, devoid of grain, brushstrokes, or organic noise. The overall atmosphere is stark, graphic, and highly stylized, reducing complex forms to their most basic geometric denominators. Every element is a solid fill, maintaining strict orthographic or flattened 2D perspective. Visual rhythm is established through the repetition of simple modular shapes. The lighting logic is entirely absent; illumination is baked into the intrinsic brightness of the flat color fields, ensuring zero variation in value across any single shape. The material quality mimics pristine modern digital vector graphics, prioritizing absolute clarity and graphical punch over realism. video.motion: Elements slide along horizontal or diagonal axes in a rigid, mechanical fashion without organic deformation. Transformations occur through sudden scale pops or precise positional shifts, maintaining the flat 2D illusion.
video.camera: A static orthographic camera or slow, perfectly linear 2D panning without any perspective distortion or parallax depth.
video.temporal_texture: Colors, edges, and shapes remain absolutely stable and mathematically precise frame-to-frame, with zero flickering, noise, or lighting changes.
video.avoid: Avoid 3D camera rotations, motion blur, organic morphing, gradient shifts, or any introduction of dynamic lighting and shadows.
